Package org.cibseven.bpm.impl.juel

Class ExpressionAccessPolicy

java.lang.Object
org.cibseven.bpm.impl.juel.ExpressionAccessPolicy
public final class ExpressionAccessPolicy extends Object
Deny list for JUEL expressions and scripts (deniedExpressionAccess); other script languages and the Scala-based FEEL engine are not restricted. Comma-separated entries, matched in full, * as wildcard:
  • getClass: a property or method name; property foo also as getFoo/isFoo. Map keys are not checked by name.
  • java.lang.Runtime: a type (with nested types, binary name Map$Entry) or package, checked against the accessed object with its supertypes, every result and the declaring type of a function. A Class counts as the type it represents, a member as its declaring type.
  • lang:import: an EL function, :name one without prefix.
  • com.customer.Admin#delete: a member of that type and its subtypes.

Entries extend the defaults; -entry removes a default (getClass() needs -class,-getClass,-java.lang.Class), mode off disables the list. The PROTECTED_TYPES cannot be removed. Thread-safe; report deduplication is approximate.
